# Awesome Codex + Blender + Seedance Workflows

> A zero-runtime-dependency, executable repository for compiling structured Codex shot plans into Blender gray-box previs videos and reviewed Seedance 2.0 requests through HiAPI.

## Start here

- Read `/AGENTS.md` before editing a shot.
- Copy one `/examples/*/shot.json` file into a new example directory.
- Use `outputs/<shot-id>` as the canonical directory for both compile and render artifacts.
- Run `npm test`, `npm run compile -- <shot.json> --out-dir outputs/<shot-id>`, then `npm run render -- <shot.json> --out-dir outputs/<shot-id>`.
- Inspect `review/contact-sheet.png` and `review-report.json`, then review the complete previs, finish `review-checklist.md`, and set the matching report's `humanReviewComplete` to true before paid submission.
- Never submit a paid task without the exact current endpoint-bound preflight token and user approval.
- Preserve a `preflight-<token>.pending.json` journal after an ambiguous POST failure; retry the same API credential and unchanged inputs only inside its 23-hour safe window, then reconcile task history and billing instead of resubmitting.

## Important files

- `/schemas/shot-spec.schema.json`: public shot contract.
- `/scripts/lib/spec.mjs`: validation and compilation.
- `/scripts/blender/render_previs.py`: constrained Blender renderer.
- `/scripts/lib/review.mjs`: verified stills, contact sheet, signal checks, optional blocking SVG, and human checklist.
- `/scripts/submit.mjs`: dry-run, idempotent submit, recovery journal, poll, resume, and validated download lifecycle.
- `/docs/PLAN.md`: current and future scope.
- `/docs/research.md`: related projects and non-copying boundary.
